name: Earn Crypto Rewards with the Gemini Credit Card®

localized_names.en: Earn Crypto Rewards with the Gemini Credit Card®

apr.notes: 16.49% to 34.49% variable APR based on creditworthiness. Penalty APR up to 33.49%. Maximum APR 35.99%. Per Cardholder Agreement dated 2026-04-01.

credit_required.notes: Typically good to excellent credit. Wide APR range (16.49-34.49%) suggests acceptance across a broad credit spectrum.

base_rate.description: 1% back in crypto on all other qualifying purchases

categories.label: Groceries (traditional grocery and specialty food stores)

rewards.redemption_notes: Rewards earned in cryptocurrency (bitcoin or 50+ cryptos on Gemini) and instantly deposited into Gemini account. Change crypto reward selection at any time. 4% gas/transit category limited to $300/month, then 1% thereafter. 10% back available at select merchants through Gemini Merchant Reward Program.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees on purchases made outside the U.S.

benefits.title: Instant Crypto Rewards Deposit
benefits.description: Crypto rewards instantly deposited into Gemini account within minutes of swiping card (some transactions post 24-72 hours later).

benefits.title: Flexible Crypto Reward Selection
benefits.description: Choose from bitcoin or 50+ cryptos available on Gemini. Change crypto reward as often as desired.

benefits.title: 10% Back at Select Merchants
benefits.description: Earn 10% back in crypto at select merchants through Gemini Merchant Reward Program. Subject to monthly spend limits.

benefits.title: Credit Card Referral Program
benefits.description: Get $50 in crypto per referral and $250 bonus per 5 referrals. Up to 50 referrals per year (up to $5,000 in crypto).

notes: Issued by WebBank, managed by Gemini. World Elite Mastercard. No current signup bonus (prior $200 bitcoin offer discontinued). Rewards paid in cryptocurrency.
